title: GO-AuNP-Autonomous-Design: dataset and code for active-learning design of graphene oxide–gold nanoparticle nanocomposites under multi-source feedstock variability
description: Literature seed (text-mined AuNP syntheses normalized with PubChem identifiers), laboratory records of graphene oxide batches (XPS, Raman, AFM with uncertainty), AuNP syntheses on GO (UV-Vis, TEM) and optimization outcomes, protocols, models and code (GO Navigator, AuNP Designer, transfer learning, benchmarking). FAPESP undergraduate research project, UNESP – Institute of Chemistry, Araraquara.

creators.name: Lopes, Rafael
creators.affiliation: Universidade Estadual Paulista (UNESP), Instituto de Química, Araraquara
